updatedBy: ChatGPT KLMA and GigsNews source-semantics audit
title: bndy workboard
description: Single view of active bndy product, platform, ingestion, intelligence and growth work.
principles: Canonical BNDY APIs remain the write authority.
Capture is transport and durable intake, not the intelligence engine.
Enrichment is the strategic resolution and intelligence runtime.
All new ingestion paths should converge on Capture + Enrichment rather than inventing another write path.
The target state is evidence -> claims -> projection -> canonical BNDY, not source -> direct database write.

repositories.role: Core public gig discovery PWA: map, gigs, artists, venues, festivals, favourites and public add flows.
Authoritative artists, venues, events, festivals, auth, curator policy, source inspection and edition-aware APIs.
Admin operations, curator policy management and traffic visibility.
Public brand, proposition, policy and architecture pages. The workboard lives here.
Public Dropzone UI for gig poster and text submission. Routes into Capture.
Durable intake transport for Android Send to bndy and public web submissions. Stores evidence and queue state.
Capture processing, Facebook/event resolution, source acquisition, identity matching and the strategic evidence/claims/projection architecture.
Thin agent-facing adapter around BNDY capabilities. Needs a current-role audit as Enrichment becomes the orchestration layer.
Older Signal -> interpretation -> claims implementation. Useful concepts should be absorbed then the runtime retired.
Previous public application. Do not use for new work.
Shared type definitions used by older/newer surfaces where applicable.
Shared UI package from the earlier application generation. Audit before expanding usage.

repositories.repo: flowency-live/bndy.live, bndylivebeta, bndy-centrestage, bndy-portal, bndy-api, bndy-infrastructure

done.title: Ticketing surfaced at event and venue level

now.title: Keep all public CRUD on canonical APIs

now.title: Separate product UX from evidence architecture

now.title: Curator festival parity

next.title: Festival ingestion through Enrichment
next.detail: Source-discovered festival data should become claims and project into canonical festivals/events.

lanes.title: Curators & Godmode

done.title: Postcode-area restrictions
done.detail: Curator access policies can be limited by configured postcode areas.

done.title: Ownership restrictions
done.detail: Curators can be restricted to records they created, while trusted curators can be broader.

done.title: Godmode policy editor
done.detail: Backstage has curator permission management and creator provenance is recorded by public wizards.

now.title: Production verification
now.detail: Exercise postcode, own-only and trusted/global combinations against artists, venues, events and festivals.

next.title: Curator dashboard
next.detail: Give curators a clear view of their area, records, outstanding quality issues and recent submissions.

lanes.title: Facebook artist assist
lanes.objective: Paste a Facebook artist URL and let BNDY resolve enough trustworthy data to make creation effortless.

done.title: Facebook source inspector
done.detail: Backend handles About data, mbasic/title fallbacks, profile wrappers and rejects Facebook login/error/system identities.

done.title: Artist form prefill
done.detail: Standalone Add Artist and Add Gig can prefill source-backed name/location/bio/website hints and persist them.

done.title: Inspector route hardened
done.detail: Recent deploy work keeps the companion source-inspector route present after normal API deployments.

now.title: Still a direct canonical creation path
now.detail: The resolver helps the UI, but accepted data is still written directly through canonical creation rather than becoming durable claims first.

next.title: Converge with Enrichment evidence model
next.detail: Reuse the same Observation/Extraction/Interpretation/Claim pipeline used by automated ingestion.

next.title: Show evidence confidence in the form
next.detail: Differentiate observed Facebook facts, inferred values and mere handle/name hints.

lanes.title: chat.bndy.live public ingestion
lanes.objective: Let anyone submit a gig poster or event text and get a useful, low-friction result.

done.title: Disconnected from bndy-signals
done.detail: The public Dropzone no longer uses the old Signals/Textract/Haiku claims UI.

done.title: Multimodal poster interpretation
done.detail: Poster processing uses the actual image in the Capture/Enrichment path, avoiding OCR-only mistakes.

done.title: Useful result response
done.detail: Added/already-existing results show artist, venue, date/time and a direct bndy.live gig link.

now.title: Processing latency
now.detail: Public submissions still rely on the periodic scanner before reaching SQS; this can add minutes of dead time.

next.title: Enqueue immediately on submission
next.detail: Send the Capture message to the processing queue at create time and keep the scanner only as a recovery safety net.

next.title: Richer live progress
next.detail: Show resolving artist, matching venue, deduping event and final result rather than a generic spinner.

lanes.title: Send to bndy / Capture transport
lanes.objective: One durable intake layer for Android, web, WhatsApp, Messenger and future channels.

done.title: Android share target
done.detail: Send to bndy accepts shared URLs/text/images, writes locally first and syncs to capture.bndy.co.uk.

done.title: Durable AWS backlog
done.detail: Capture API, DynamoDB and S3 provide transport-independent evidence storage and processing state.

done.title: Facebook event sharing proven
done.detail: Opaque Facebook /share URLs are resolved to exact canonical event URLs, deduped and projected safely.

done.title: Public Dropzone transport added
done.detail: chat.bndy.live uses the same Capture intake instead of a parallel backend.

now.title: Capture is not the resolution engine
now.detail: It is the transport/backlog. bndy-enrichment performs interpretation, matching and canonical projection.

next.title: Immediate queue dispatch
next.detail: Remove the normal-path dependency on the five-minute scanner.

next.title: Transport idempotency
next.detail: Add stronger submission idempotency and lease recovery for unattended/high-volume use.

lanes.title: Intelligence, claims & inference
lanes.objective: Make sources produce evidence and claims; let policy derive BNDY truth.

done.title: Target architecture defined
done.detail: bndy-enrichment documents Observation, Extraction, Interpretation, Claim, EvidencePack, authority policy, tombstones and projection workers.

done.title: Strategic projection worker exists
done.detail: The new projection engine consumes durable Claims, applies authority/tombstone policy and writes through canonical BNDY APIs.

done.title: KLMA dual-path vertical slice proven
done.detail: A live KLMA source fetch has been proven through Observation + Claims + graph-shaped knowledge and additive canonical BNDY projection with production read-back verification.

done.title: Capture interpretation runs in Enrichment
done.detail: Facebook events and posters already use the newer enrichment runtime for resolution.

done.title: Canonical APIs remain the write boundary
done.detail: Artist, venue and event uniqueness/dedupe is enforced centrally.

now.title: Dual-path operating rule
now.detail: Building durable evidence/claims must not delay live gig publication. During migration a source can create claims and still project immediately through canonical BNDY APIs.

now.title: Source authority is source-specific
now.detail: KLMA is a controlled enduring community calendar and can support immediate additive projection. GigsNews is a human-curated weekly aggregation, so absence from a later page is not by itself cancellation evidence.

now.title: Critical convergence gap
now.detail: Capture and Facebook-assisted public creation resolve intelligently, then still call canonical creation directly. The full durable claims/projection path is not yet authoritative for every source.

now.title: Two generations of claims thinking exist
now.detail: bndy-signals contains the older cognitive runtime; bndy-enrichment contains the strategic architecture.

next.title: Make claims/projection the shared write path
next.detail: Capture, Add Artist, source crawlers, WhatsApp and Messenger should all emit claims into one projection pipeline.

next.title: Migrate useful Signals concepts
next.detail: Salvage source adapters, review semantics and useful ADRs from bndy-signals, then retire its runtime.

next.title: Expose intelligence operationally
next.detail: Add claim/evidence provenance and confidence views to Godmode so data decisions are inspectable.

lanes.title: Automated source acquisition
lanes.objective: Continuously discover grassroots artists, venues and gigs without manual database entry.

done.title: Source Registry and Source Runner built
done.detail: Strategic queues, dispatcher, browser/standard acquisition, snapshot semantics and projection work items exist in bndy-enrichment.

done.title: KLMA live vertical slice proven
done.detail: KLMA can fetch the live enduring Google Sheet, create immutable observations and claims, project a safe additive sample through canonical Artist/Venue/Event APIs, and verify the event by read-back. Most rows already exist in BNDY; the important recurring behaviour is detecting newly added gigs as the same sheet evolves.

done.title: GigsNews parser/adapter and parity harness ported
done.detail: The recurring GigsNews HTML structure has been ported and parity/cutover tooling exists. This is not yet live scheduled ingestion into BNDY.

done.title: Canonical duplicate gates proven
done.detail: Artist, venue and event APIs safely reject duplicates while returning reusable canonical identity.

now.title: Keep Cowork scheduled sources live during migration
now.detail: The existing Claude Cowork jobs remain operational until each replacement has an AWS schedule, production projection and freshness verification. Migration must not create a gap in gig coverage.

now.title: KLMA is an evolving enduring source
now.detail: The same Google Sheet is repeatedly updated through the year. AWS should snapshot/diff it, ignore the many gigs already in BNDY and immediately project only genuinely new additions or safe corrections.

now.title: KLMA is also a source we intend to retire
now.detail: KLMA Stoke is controlled by BNDY's operator. After the AWS feed proves parity, move community input directly into BNDY so the Google Sheet and its Cowork job can be retired rather than preserved indefinitely.

now.title: GigsNews is a different source model
now.detail: Chris manually republishes gigs from a stable set of venues into a weekly HTML page after watching venue Facebook listings. BNDY has parser/parity code, but still needs the actual scheduled ingestion/cutover path.

next.title: Operationalise KLMA as first full source replacement
next.detail: Schedule the evolving Google Sheet in AWS, persist each snapshot/observation, diff against prior state and canonical BNDY, immediately project new gigs, report each run and prove freshness before disabling the KLMA Cowork task.

next.title: Replace KLMA input with direct BNDY contribution
next.detail: Once the feed is safely AWS-operated, design the direct BNDY input route for the KLMA community so the external sheet stops being the system people update.

next.title: Build GigsNews production ingestion
next.detail: Turn the ported parser/adapter into a scheduled AWS source: acquire the weekly HTML, snapshot it, identify new or changed listings, create claims/evidence and project safe additions through canonical APIs.

next.title: Treat GigsNews disappearance cautiously
next.detail: Because the page is rebuilt manually each week, a missing listing should not automatically cancel a BNDY event. Cancellation/removal needs explicit source semantics or corroborating evidence.

next.title: Migrate remaining Cowork sources by their own semantics
next.detail: Do not assume one generic scraper model. Classify each remaining source as enduring calendar, periodic snapshot, rolling feed or other before defining diff and authority behaviour.

lanes.title: Venue listing workers
lanes.objective: Keep high-value venue calendars fresh by revisiting known reliable venue websites on a predictable cadence.

done.title: Capability fits the Source Registry model
done.detail: Known venue websites are sources. Their pages can be scheduled, observed, interpreted into event claims and deduped through the normal projection path.

now.title: Define the watched-venue registry
now.detail: Identify venues with reliable, actively maintained listings and store source URL, parsing/acquisition strategy, cadence and last successful scan.

next.title: Weekly venue worker schedule
next.detail: Run one source job per watched venue weekly, with retry/backoff and a faster cadence only where evidence justifies it.

next.title: Delta new listings into Claims
next.detail: Only new/changed gigs become claims. Existing gigs dedupe normally; removed listings are not treated as cancellations unless source semantics are explicit.

next.title: Venue freshness dashboard
next.detail: Show last checked, last changed, failures and new gigs found in Godmode so reliable sources can be expanded safely.

now.title: Not built yet

next.title: Cloud API webhook
next.detail: Verify Meta signature, acknowledge quickly, enqueue work and map text/media into Capture.

next.title: Public BNDY number
next.detail: Configure the BNDY WhatsApp Business number and simple acknowledgement/status replies.

now.title: Evidence-first brass discovery

next.title: Deploy isolated brass read path

next.title: Explicit public route allowlist

next.title: Finish SDK/dependency hardening

lanes.title: Public website & proposition

next.title: Archive or label legacy repos

next.title: Define repo ownership map
